title: Good Old Friends
wikitext:
Good Old Friends was created by [[jOn]] in 2015 as a Discord channel meant to bring together old friends (and the occasional enemy) to play QuakeWorld and idle. Most people, however, just idled. Somewhere along the way — in late 2025, to be exact — it accidentally turned into a clan.

Feel free to join the Discord channel here: https://discord.gg/4hKsVTaF
